caption: The drawing depicts a single dress as its central object, rendered in fine pencil lines on a beige or light tan background. The dress is short-sleeved, with wide, square sleeves and a square neckline, and features lace detailing along the edges of the sleeves, neckline, and peplum. The bodice includes horizontal pleats and lace panels, with a fitted waist leading to a skirt that is full and gathered, ending in a flounced hem with more lace and embroidered patterns. Across the skirt, there are horizontal bands of intricate floral embroidery and stitching. In the lower left and right corners of the drawing, there are two detail sketches showing close-up views of specific embroidered floral patterns and lacework from the dress, each done in the same pencil style as the main figure. The entire composition is monochromatic, created using varying intensities of pencil or graphite on paper, highlighting the texture and ornamental elements of the textile.
title: Child's Dress
